description: List all accounts in the chart of accounts. Returns AcctNum (the user-facing account number), Name, AccountType, AccountSubType, and CurrentBalance. Use AcctNum to reference accounts in other queries or operations.

account_type.description: Optional filter by account type (e.g., 'Bank', 'Expense', 'Income', 'Other Current Asset', 'Fixed Asset', 'Other Current Liability', 'Equity')

active_only.description: If true, only return active accounts (default: true)

name: list_accounts
